name: Alex
source:
He is a self-proclaimed otaku who frequents maid cafes and arcades with bullet hell games. Alex frequently gets excited about things that Ryou doesn’t understand. Still Ryou finds himself hanging out with Alex as he does find Alex’s world interesting at times.

Ryou then hears that this “Otaku” was once one of the legendary “players” called the Wings of Light. Then Ryou receives a mysterious email from someone claiming to be a “player”. Could it be Alex trying to help Ryou out? It may be key to figuring out what is bothering Claire.

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=47]MangaGamer[/url]]
